title: How to organise the guest vanity counter | Guest Bathroom
description:
It gives a visitor somewhere to wash their hands and set a phone down, with nothing of yours in the way.

This is the Guest Vanity Counter in the Guest Bathroom. About 15-30 min.

WHAT DONE LOOKS LIKE
A soap pump above half full, one folded hand towel on the ring where you can see it from the doorway, a box of tissues at the back corner, and enough bare counter to set down a phone and a pair of glasses. No toothbrush cup holding your family's toothbrushes, no hair clips behind the tap, no dried soap ring under the dispenser.

THE SIX PASSES
Sort: Take everything off the counter and put back only what a visitor would use: soap, tissues, hand towel.
Straighten: Set the soap on the side your hand reaches without crossing over the basin, tissues at the back corner clear o
Shine: Wipe the counter, then the tap and the drain lip where toothpaste film and hard water scale build up, includin
Safety: Water and electricity: a shaver or hair dryer left plugged in beside a full basin is a live cord within splash
Standardize: Three things live on this counter permanently: soap, tissues, hand towel.
Sustain: The moment someone confirms they are coming over, walk in, top up the soap, and hang a fresh hand towel.

THE STANDARD YOU LEAVE BEHIND
The counter holds three things: soap, tissues, hand towel.
